title: A fictional old-version session drain
method: Synthetic old-version session counts at activation and 5, 10, and 20 minutes: 60, 40, 15, 0. Counts illustrate retirement observation, not a guaranteed drain rate. No linear extrapolation or zero-interruption claim is implied; transactions and external work require their own checks.
alt: A fictional old-version session drain. Illustrative values: At activation 60 active old sessions, After 5 minutes 40 active old sessions, After 10 minutes 15 active old sessions, After 20 minutes 0 active old sessions.
